A comparative split illustration of shifting cultivation and bush fallowing. On the left (Shifting Cultivation), a farmer is shown packing their belongings onto their head and abandoning a depleted farm plot with withered crops, moving entirely to a distant virgin forest. On the right (Bush Fallowing), a farmer remains living in their permanent village hut, while arrows point between different farm plots nearby, showing rotation from a harvested field left to rest (overgrown with weeds) to a freshly planted field.

A split scene showing rural agricultural infrastructure problems and solutions. Top half (Problem): a broken-down delivery truck carrying tomatoes stuck on a muddy, unpaved rural road, with baskets of rotten tomatoes on the ground. Bottom half (Solution): a smooth paved feeder road with a modern delivery truck driving towards a clean, solar-powered agricultural storage facility.
